disclosure: Salesforce is priced at the public list price of the license that includes everything listed here. Your account team will confirm scope.
formula: salesforce = (salesSeats + serviceSeats) * seatPrice * 12 * years. hubspot = seats * seatPrice * 12 * years + onboardingPerHub * hubs (one-time; hubs with seats > 0) + sum(monthly of each need picked) * 12 * years.

presentationRules: Never name editions in rendered copy. Compare one Salesforce license with HubSpot's top tier and the add-ons it takes to match.
Never claim Salesforce is cheaper overall. Only the scoped verdict: 'for what you picked ... at list'. When Salesforce costs more, say the per-user gap and what the license includes.
Never compare AI cost per resolution. Don't state a Flex Credit allotment period.
Always show the disclaimer and the disclosure beside the results.
